title: Faithfulness vs. Safety: Evaluating LLM Behavior Under Counterfactual Medical Evidence
reasoning: The term 'faithfulness' in the title and throughout the paper refers to the technical NLP concept of 'faithfulness to context' (adhering to provided evidence/grounding) rather than religious or spiritual faith. The research focuses on medical safety and evidence adherence, which are technical and safety evaluations, not an evaluation of religious beliefs, morals, or ethics.
